items.quote: Bitte begleichen Sie den Betrag binnen 14 Tagen ab dem Rechnungsdatum ohne Abzug.
items.computation: The invoice is dated 19.11.2026 (Thursday) and the payment period runs 'binnen 14 Tagen ab dem Rechnungsdatum' (within 14 days from the invoice date). Since the period is expressed as running from the date of the invoice itself (an event-based period under §187 Abs. 1 BGB), the day of the invoice (19.11.) is not counted; counting starts on 20.11.2026 as day 1. Day 14 falls on 03.12.2026 (20-30 Nov = 11 days, 01-03 Dec = 3 days, total 14 days). 03.12.2026 is a Thursday, not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NRW, so §193 BGB does not shift the date. Due date: 03.12.2026.
